# gemini_cli_sdk v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

An Elixir SDK for the Gemini CLI - build AI-powered applications with Google Gemini.

## Modules

- [GeminiCliSdk.Session.Entry](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Session.Entry.md): Structured Gemini CLI resumable session entry.

- Public API
  - [GeminiCliSdk](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.md): An Elixir SDK for the Gemini CLI.

- Types
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.md): Type definitions and stream event parsing for the Gemini CLI SDK.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types.ErrorEvent](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.ErrorEvent.md): A non-fatal error or warning event.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types.InitEvent](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.InitEvent.md): Session initialization event.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types.MessageEvent](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.MessageEvent.md): A message event (user or assistant).
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types.ResultEvent](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.ResultEvent.md): Final session result event.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types.Stats](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.Stats.md): Aggregated session statistics.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types.ToolResultEvent](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.ToolResultEvent.md): A tool execution result event.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Types.ToolUseEvent](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Types.ToolUseEvent.md): A tool call request event.

- Errors
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Error](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Error.md): Unified error type for the Gemini CLI SDK.

- Configuration
  - [GeminiCliSdk.ArgBuilder](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.ArgBuilder.md): Converts an `Options` struct into a list of CLI arguments.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.CLI](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.CLI.md): Resolves the Gemini CLI binary location through the shared
`CliSubprocessCore.ProviderCLI` policy.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Config](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Config.md): Manages temporary settings files for Gemini CLI configuration.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Configuration](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Configuration.md): Centralized numeric constants and compatibility defaults.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Env](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Env.md): Builds the subprocess environment for Gemini CLI invocations.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Models](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Models.md): Centralized model name constants and helpers.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Options](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Options.md): Configuration for a Gemini CLI invocation.

- Internals
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Command](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Command.md): Synchronous Gemini command helpers built on the shared core command lane.

  - [GeminiCliSdk.Runtime.CLI](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Runtime.CLI.md): Session-oriented runtime kit for the shared Gemini CLI lane.
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Session](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Session.md): Session management operations (list, resume, delete).
  - [GeminiCliSdk.Stream](https://gemini-cli-sdk.hexdocs.pm/GeminiCliSdk.Stream.md): Lazy streaming execution of Gemini CLI prompts via `Stream.resource/3`.
